sourceNotes: macOS 26 及更新版本新增全屏分页启动台，支持拼音搜索、拖动排序与文件夹整理
启动台支持可选的四指／五指捏合与触发角，默认关闭，可在功能设置中开启
新增 DNS 测试窗口
命令栏支持搜索和启动应用、收藏与最近使用，新增拼音搜索及端口、进程、Homebrew 参数查询
Homebrew 更新确认支持按需展开影响预览，卸载前检查已安装依赖方，应用来源可查看识别依据
修复 Homebrew 更新确认可能无响应的问题，更新与卸载完成后核验实际结果，避免误报成功

en: Add a full-screen, paginated Launchpad on macOS 26 and later, with pinyin search, drag-to-reorder, and folders.
Add optional four- or five-finger pinch gestures and hot corners for Launchpad. Both are off by default and can be enabled in feature settings.
Add a DNS test window to compare UDP, TCP, DoT, and DoH latency and reliability, with custom servers and no changes to system DNS.
Let the command bar find and launch apps, keep favorites and recent items, and search by pinyin or query ports, processes, and Homebrew packages with parameters.
Offer an optional impact preview before Homebrew updates, check installed dependents before uninstalling, and show the evidence used to identify an app's installation source.
Fix unresponsive Homebrew update confirmations and verify the actual result after updates and uninstalls instead of reporting success prematurely.
